title: Pregabalin In Partial Seizures (PREPS): An Open-Label, Multicenter Add On Therapy Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the clinical improvement by partial seizures reduction, safety and tolerability of subjects having partial epilepsy related to the adjunction of pregabalin BID (75 to 300mg day titration, BID) to existing standard AED (Antiepileptic drugs).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female who are diagnosed of partial seizure (simple partial, complex partial, partial seizure secondarily generalized) as defined in the international league of epilepsy classification of seizure.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients having a treatable cause of seizure, currently receiving vigabatrin, having a progressive neurological or systemic disorder.
